verdict.rationale: Browserbase's site states that its fetch capability converts any URL into HTML, JSON or markdown, which directly matches the story of getting clean markdown instead of raw HTML. The only support is a single marketing line, with no detailed docs or hands-on confirmation. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the markdown output (API parameters, cleanliness and fidelity of the conversion), independent or hands-on corroboration that the markdown is clean.
